{{Quote|On distant Generis stands an especially dark, dense, and near impenetrable growth of sallap trees. For many generations it was necessary to travel a long distance around the forest to reach the glorious deep-water lake on the far side. But then a Sith Lord thought to blaze a trail directly through the trees, in the hope of providing a quicker route to the lake.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Cloak" />}}
The '''sallap''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Generis/Legends|Generis]],<ref name="Cloak" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|331|Generis}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] once related a parable to his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of a particularly dense growth of sallap trees growing near a [[Water/Legends|lake]] on Generis. According to Jinn, for several generations, those that wanted to visit the lake were forced to skirt the large sallap [[Forest/Legends|forest]], taking a long and circuitous path to the lake. A [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], however, opted to blaze a path directly through the copse in order to reach the lake by a faster route. Ultimately, his path never reached the lake, as testified by others that tread it after him. Jinn used this story when Kenobi was concerned that he might have been influenced by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] while on a [[Mission to Asmeru|mission]] to [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]].<ref name="Cloak" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sallap appeared in ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', a [[2001]] novel written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Cloak" />
